attributes.board_name: DC Board of Marriage and Family Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs and activities approved by the Board under 17 DCMR §7708
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal after initial licensure is exempt from CE.
rules.audit_note: The Board may audit up to 20% of licensees.

topics.who: LGBTQ cultural competency (separate from public health priority hours)
10% of required CE in DC Health public health priority topics

rules.notes: At least 15 of 30 hours live face-to-face with real-time interaction. Moving to birth-month expiry (renewal in odd/even years matching birth year); transition: 50% CE accepted if under 2 years on the term, LGBTQ and public health hours still due.
rules.rule_quote: To qualify for the renewal of a license, an applicant shall have completed thirty (30) hours of approved continuing education during the two (2)-year period preceding the date the license expires…
